summary: Extract Crossref search and sync rows from message.items and retain uppercase DOI as the stable work identity.
reason: Crossref list responses wrap rows under message.items and use an uppercase DOI key. Ignoring the envelope yields an empty search or sync, and a missing DOI identity prevents stable local upserts.
validated_outcome: Synthetic Crossref message.items tests confirm search extracts one work and sync identifies that work by its uppercase DOI.
